properties.description: A conditional loop_hint rides the orientation-shaped reads (graph_report, graph_report_markdown, scan_nodes, search_design, get_node) and surfaces outstanding coherence-loop debt at the agent's most frequent action — the mid-session trigger between SessionStart (fires once) and Stop (fires at the end). Option C of dec:read-hint-shape: the pointer appears ONLY when loop_status would report real debt (never static-every-read), and only when the owed-set has CHANGED since it was last surfaced (fire-on-change). The owed-set can change only on a write, so the recompute is gated on a service write-generation counter, bounding per-read cost. The read-side sibling of the write tools' static loop_hint (dec:loop-status-state-not-history).
properties.name: Reads surface loop debt when it's real
